content.short: Solana-based decentralized lending protocol that lets users borrow USDH against their assets and charges a one-time 0.5% fee for minting and redeeming USDH.
content.description: Hubble is a decentralized lending protocol on Solana that lets users mint the USDH stablecoin by depositing collateral, providing liquidity for long‑term holdings. It charges a one-time 0.5% fee for minting and redeeming USDH rather than a traditional long‑term interest rate. Hubble has a native token, HBB, which is intended to become the governance token when the project transitions to a DAO. In spirit, it’s a Solana‑based version of MakerDAO.
